The Safentia console

Fire risk assessment, evidenced.

Assessors capture evidence on site, auditors validate it question by question, and the Responsible Person receives a report they can act on.

  • Capture offlineTemplated questions, titled photo evidence and floor-plan flags on a native app.
  • Validate with named stagesEvery assessment moves through a fixed lifecycle, from Assessment in progress to Released.
  • Release a branded reportOn release, a formal PDF is generated server-side: risk profile, transparent question tables and a severity-ordered action plan.

Invited by the organisation that assesses your buildings? Signing in shows you your own buildings, scores and released reports.
